title: Travel: John Lennon – Cairo to New York | 1979
content:
John Lennon, Yoko Ono, and Sean Lennon flew from Cairo to New York on 24 January 1979.

It had been a brief holiday was a brief one. They arrived in Egypt on 21 January, spending just three days there before returning to the USA.

Page last updated: 12 May 2026

  • 1969: Get Back/Let It Be sessions: day 15
  • 1967: Paul McCartney and Brian Epstein discuss The Beatles’ third film with Joe Orton
  • 1964: The Beatles live: Olympia Theatre, Paris

  • 1962: The Beatles live: Cavern Club, Liverpool (lunchtime)
  • 1959: The Quarrymen live: Woolton Village Club, Liverpool
